threat_event: Ransomware encrypts BAS servers and spreads across flat property networks into corporate systems, leaving BAS Platform B and parts of Platform A without supervisory control
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flat networks at 8 properties; Integrator B always-on remote tool with a shared account; unsupported Platform B servers without EDR; untested BAS recovery
existing_controls: OT zones at Towers 1-4; remote access gateway for Integrator A; EDR with 24x7 MSSP on IT and console PCs; write-once backups of Platform A
treatment_plan: Move Integrator B to the gateway; OT zones at 10 properties; Platform B backups and controller program copies; quarterly restore tests; OT ransomware tabletop 2026-11-19
exposure_estimate_usd: $1.5M-$4M (5-day portfolio BAS outage about $650K per P05, plus response, rebuild, and tenant concessions)

threat_event: Compromise of BAS Integrator B or its remote-support tool gives an attacker control of all 8 Platform B servers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on vendor tool; one shared account; no MFA, approval, or session logging; no security terms in the contract
existing_controls: None beyond the integrator's own controls
treatment_plan: Remove the tool; integrator access only through the gateway with named accounts, MFA, and per-session approval; security addendum
exposure_estimate_usd: $400K-$1.2M (8 properties degraded; rebuild by a second integrator)

threat_event: Ransomware on corporate IT and cloud workloads (file storage, data warehouse, historian) disrupts accounting, leasing, and reporting
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Phishing and exposed services; flat networks at 8 properties let OT compromise reach IT
existing_controls: MFA; EDR with 24x7 MSSP; write-once backups in a separate account; guardrails
treatment_plan: Quarterly restore tests for file storage and the data warehouse; egress alerting on the cloud firewall

threat_event: A Platform B site server fails (hardware, malware, or a bad update) and cannot be restored, leaving a property without supervisory BAS control for days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No backups of Platform B servers; controller programs and graphics held only by Integrator B; 2 server failures in 2025 needed integrator rebuilds of 3 and 6 days
existing_controls: Local hand control by chief engineers; integrator service agreement
treatment_plan: Nightly images of Platform B servers to the backup account; controller program exports after each change; restore test per server
exposure_estimate_usd: $60K-$250K per property (overtime, rentals, abatement after day 3 at office parks)

threat_event: Compromise of the cloud access control and video platform exposes credential records for about 14,500 tenant employees and lets an attacker change door schedules
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single multi-tenant SaaS platform for doors and video at all 14 properties; no export of administrator audit events to the SIEM
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 Type 2; security keys for administrators; door controllers cache credentials
treatment_plan: Annual vendor review with CUEC mapping; export platform audit events to the SIEM; access platform runbook (P08); 24-hour vendor notice term at renewal
exposure_estimate_usd: $1M-$3M (notice to tenant employees, lease claims from 31 tenants with 72-hour clauses, officer overtime)

threat_event: Extended outage of the cloud access control platform beyond the vendor's 8-hour RTO; credentials cannot be issued or revoked across the portfolio
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single platform; vendor RTO 8 hours versus BIA RTO 2 hours for administration
existing_controls: 72-hour credential cache; officers at entrances
treatment_plan: Access platform runbook with credential freeze and printed lists; recovery terms at renewal
exposure_estimate_usd: $50K-$200K per day (officer overtime at about 60 entrances)

threat_event: A former tenant employee or former staff member enters a building using a credential that should have been revoked
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 1,900 active badges unused for 90+ days; revocation depends on tenant notice; local accounts and badges not in the termination workflow
existing_controls: Tenant revocation requests processed same day; lobby officers
treatment_plan: Suspend credentials unused for 90 days; quarterly tenant recertification; badges added to the termination workflow

threat_event: Attackers exploit internet-exposed OT devices (2 NVRs and the Park 2 BAS web interface) found by the MSSP scan
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Port forwarding created for guard contractor viewing and integrator convenience; no change control at Platform B sites
existing_controls: MSSP external scan (found it); NVR forwarding rules removed 2026-07-24
treatment_plan: Remove the Park 2 forwarding rule after the gateway cutover; monthly external scans; firewall change review

threat_event: Default or shared passwords on BAS controllers, NVRs, and Platform B accounts let an attacker on a property network change programs or video settings
threat_source: Insider or external attacker on the network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: P07 found defaults on 9 of 30 sampled OT devices; Platform B shared password unchanged since 2019
existing_controls: OT zones at Towers 1-4 limit who can reach devices there
treatment_plan: Change defaults on all OT devices; commissioning checklist; named Platform B accounts through the gateway

threat_event: Malware infects an unsupported Platform B server or workstation with no EDR
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 8 servers and 5 workstations on an OS past support; patched only at integrator visits; USB program loads
existing_controls: Firewalls at each property
treatment_plan: Platform B upgrade; until then isolation, USB control, and application allowlisting where the vendor supports it

threat_event: The energy optimization service (AI-004) writes unsafe setpoints because of a model error or a compromise of the vendor
threat_source: Supplier compromise or AI model error
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Cloud vendor holds a write path into Platform A at Towers 1-2; bounds enforced by the vendor only; no interconnection terms
existing_controls: Field controllers enforce equipment safety limits; chief engineers can override
treatment_plan: Company-enforced write limits on the connector; alerting on out-of-range writes; contract addendum (P10)

threat_event: The face verification pilot (AI-002) collects and keeps face templates for about 240 tenant employees without notice, retention limits, or accuracy evidence, leading to an FTC Section 5 claim or a breach of biometric data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor-led pilot started 2026-04 with no review; vendor keeps templates indefinitely; no demographic accuracy evidence
existing_controls: Pilot limited to one tenant at Tower 2; enrollment is opt-in
treatment_plan: Suspend the pilot and delete templates unless the P10 conditions are met; vendor to certify deletion

threat_event: Tailgating analytics (AI-001) false alerts lead officers to stop people with disabilities or with carts far more often than others
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Model treats a wheelchair user with a companion as two people; no fairness monitoring
existing_controls: Officers review the clip before acting
treatment_plan: Route accessible-lane alerts as review-only; monthly false-alert rate by lane; vendor fix (P10)

threat_event: License plate recognition data shared by the parking operator (AI-003) is kept without limits or misused in investigations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No data use or retention terms with the parking operator; plate reads linked to monthly parkers could be geolocation information
existing_controls: Requests to the operator go through the Director of Security Operations
treatment_plan: Data use and retention addendum; request log; 30-day retention for shared exports

threat_event: Generative AI lease abstraction (AI-005) misses or misstates critical dates or obligations, or confidential lease data is used by the vendor
threat_source: AI model error and vendor data use
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No review step before abstracts enter the lease system; vendor terms not reviewed
existing_controls: Lease administrators spot-check some abstracts
treatment_plan: Mandatory second review of critical dates; no-training clause; approved-tool list

threat_event: Breach of the visitor management archive (about 610,000 records with driver license numbers) triggers notice to hundreds of thousands of people
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ID scans and photos kept indefinitely since 2021; no breach notice terms in the vendor contract
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 Type 2; administrator MFA
treatment_plan: Purge scans older than 30 days; keep only name, host, and time; breach notice terms
exposure_estimate_usd: $2M-$6M (notice, call center, credit monitoring, Florida penalties for late notice)

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects tenant rent payments or vendor payments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About $8.3M billed monthly; bank detail changes requested by email
existing_controls: MFA; call-back rule for vendor bank changes; email filtering
treatment_plan: Call-back rule extended to tenant payment instructions; DMARC at reject; finance training

threat_event: Phishing with an adversary-in-the-middle kit takes over a corporate account despite push MFA
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Push MFA for non-administrators; 6.1% click rate
existing_controls: Number matching; conditional access; MSSP alerting
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA for finance and property management staff

threat_event: Takeover of one of 23 full administrator accounts on the access control platform is used to unlock doors or create credentials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Too many full administrators; administrator actions not monitored
existing_controls: Security keys for administrators
treatment_plan: Reduce to 6 administrators; alert on schedule and credential changes

threat_event: Card numbers and security codes on paper booking forms and in event mailboxes are exposed or lead the acquirer to reject the SAQ P2PE
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Phone bookings written on paper at Towers 2 and 4; 5 emails with card numbers found
existing_controls: P2PE terminals; annual SAQ
treatment_plan: Stop paper capture; purge mailboxes and block card numbers in email; staff training
exposure_estimate_usd: $20K-$150K (forensics, fines passed through by the acquirer)

threat_event: A P2PE terminal at the Retail 3 or Mixed-Use 1 office is tampered with or swapped
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No periodic inspection at the 2 non-tower offices
existing_controls: Validated P2PE solution; terminals in staffed offices
treatment_plan: Monthly inspection and staff training at all 6 offices

threat_event: Guard contractor staff share video viewing accounts; misuse cannot be traced to a person
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 shared viewing accounts; no security terms in the guard contract
existing_controls: Viewing only; no export rights
treatment_plan: Named accounts for contractor staff; contract terms

threat_event: A vendor holding company, tenant, or employee data has a breach and does not tell the company in time to meet notice duties
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 25 of 41 contracts lack incident notice clauses; no annual reassessment
existing_controls: Fla. Stat. 501.171(6) requires third-party agents to notify within 10 days
treatment_plan: Security addendum with 72-hour notice for Tier 1 vendors; annual Tier 1 reviews (P09)

threat_event: Compromise of the tenant experience app exposes about 9,800 users or lets an attacker issue mobile credentials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: App integrates with the access control platform to issue credentials; SOC 2 report not yet reviewed
existing_controls: Integration limited to issuing and revoking credentials for pre-approved users
treatment_plan: Tier 1 review; alert on bulk credential issuance

threat_event: Loss of the Security Command Center (network, power, or facility event) with no tested failover
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backup positions at Tower 3 never run for a full shift; same cloud platform
existing_controls: UPS and generator at Tower 1; cellular failover
treatment_plan: Quarterly failover drill to Tower 3 for one full shift

threat_event: Single-ISP outage isolates a retail center or office park from the cloud platforms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One ISP at 8 properties
existing_controls: Door controllers cache credentials; local NVR recording continues
treatment_plan: Cellular backup at the 8 properties

threat_event: A security operations employee misuses video to track a person
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 41 users can export video; no review of video access
existing_controls: Background checks; officer licensing
treatment_plan: Limit export to named investigators; quarterly review of video access logs

threat_event: Vulnerabilities in OT devices stay unknown and unpatched because about 45% of OT devices are not inventoried
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No passive OT discovery; integrator device lists incomplete
existing_controls: Tower inventories from the 2025 segmentation project
treatment_plan: Passive OT discovery at all 14 properties; inventory through change tickets

threat_event: An attack on the BAS or the access control platform goes undetected for days because OT and platform administrator activity is not monitored
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No OT network monitoring; BAS and platform audit logs not in the SIEM
existing_controls: MSSP monitors IT sources and console PCs
treatment_plan: Forward Platform A, gateway, and platform audit logs; passive OT monitoring service through the MSSP

threat_event: Staff take unsafe or destructive actions during an OT incident (power off controllers, factory reset) because procedures were never exercised
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: IR plan IT-only; no OT playbook exercised
existing_controls: Chief engineers' equipment knowledge
treatment_plan: P08 runbooks; tabletop 2026-11-19 with all chief engineers

threat_event: Notice deadlines are missed (Florida 30 days; 31 tenants with 72-hour clauses) because no one owns the decision log or the tenant notice register
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No breach decision log; lease notice clauses not tracked centrally
existing_controls: Outside breach counsel through the insurer
treatment_plan: Decision log and tenant notice register maintained by General Counsel

threat_event: A hurricane causes multi-day power and ISP outages at several properties at once
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Florida portfolio; cloud dependence for access control and video
existing_controls: Hurricane plan; generators at towers
treatment_plan: Coordinate the hurricane plan with OT degraded-mode procedures; satellite or cellular backup for the SCC
exposure_estimate_usd: $200K-$1M per event (operations; property damage is insured separately)

threat_event: Cloud misconfiguration exposes building drawings publicly
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual changes in the workloads account
existing_controls: Guardrails deny public storage
treatment_plan: Accept: guardrails prevent public buckets; posture service alerts

threat_event: Errors in the data warehouse produce wrong JV or lender reports
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual mapping of property ledgers
existing_controls: Controller review of each report
treatment_plan: Reconciliation checks before reports are sent

threat_event: An attacker deletes or encrypts backups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backups for Platform A only
existing_controls: Separate account, separate credentials, write-once retention
treatment_plan: Accept: design is strong; add Platform B images under R-004

threat_event: The property management system vendor is unavailable for more than 72 hours at month start
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS for billing and receivables
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 Type 2; monthly register exports
treatment_plan: Annual vendor review; offline monthly register
exposure_estimate_usd: Up to $6.5M cash delayed; about $20K cost

threat_event: The MSSP or its SIEM platform is compromised and used against company systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSSP has privileged EDR agents on all IT endpoints and console PCs
existing_controls: MSSP SOC 2 Type 2; contract terms
treatment_plan: Annual review including the SIEM platform's report; limit MSSP response actions to isolation

threat_event: Departing staff keep local BAS, console, or badge access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Local accounts and badges outside the HR workflow; P07 found 4 of 25 terminations with access remaining
existing_controls: Identity provider disabled automatically
treatment_plan: Termination checklist for local accounts and badges; monthly reconciliation

threat_event: Camera or NVR firmware vulnerabilities are exploited by a botnet
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Firmware not tracked; mixed camera fleet
existing_controls: NVRs behind firewalls; no internet exposure after the July fix
treatment_plan: Firmware inventory and twice-yearly updates by the integrator

threat_event: Missing standards lead to inconsistent configurations across 14 properties
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2024 policies without OT, configuration, logging, or vendor standards
existing_controls: Policies POL-01 to POL-05
treatment_plan: Issue the P06 standards

threat_event: Without platform audit logs the company cannot show whether tenant employee data was accessed, so it must assume a breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Platform audit events kept 90 days by the vendor and not exported
existing_controls: Vendor console search
treatment_plan: Export audit events to the log bucket with 3-year retention

threat_event: Video is deleted before it is needed as evidence, or kept far longer than needed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Retention 14 to 90 days by property with no rule
existing_controls: Legal hold by email to the Director of Security Operations
treatment_plan: Standard 30-day retention with legal hold procedure

threat_event: Denial-of-service attack on the tenant app or the company website
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Public-facing SaaS
existing_controls: Vendor DDoS protection
treatment_plan: Accept: vendor protection is adequate; temporary cards and email fall back

threat_event: CIRCIA final rule keeps the size criterion and the company must report covered incidents within 72 hours and ransom payments within 24 hours before it is ready
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Company exceeds the SBA size standard; OT incidents not logged well enough to support a report
existing_controls: P08 matrix tracks CIRCIA as pending; voluntary CISA reporting in the runbooks
treatment_plan: Monitor the final rule; dry-run a CIRCIA-style report in the 2026-11-19 tabletop

threat_event: Acquired retail centers bring unknown OT systems and vendor remote access onto the network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two retail centers under contract for 2027; no security due diligence step
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Security due diligence checklist; isolate acquired networks until assessed

threat_event: Engineering tablets on Wi-Fi bridge the flat retail networks to BAS controllers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared Wi-Fi at 3 retail centers
existing_controls: MDM on tablets
treatment_plan: Separate engineering SSID per OT zone

threat_event: An integrator connects a fire alarm or elevator system to the BAS network, creating a path from the BAACS to life-safety systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Integrator convenience; no change control at Platform B; vendor proposals for 'smart' integration
existing_controls: Design rule in the SSP; life-safety vendors maintain separate networks
treatment_plan: Design rule in integrator contracts; annual walkdown of relay points; change review for any life-safety interface

threat_event: A ransom is paid without an OFAC sanctions check
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written ransom decision process before P06
existing_controls: Insurer involvement
treatment_plan: POL-03 ransom decision rule with OFAC check

threat_event: The SOC 2 Type 2 report required by the JV management agreement is not delivered by 2027-12-31
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Readiness gaps in recovery, vendor management, and OT monitoring (P09)
existing_controls: P09 readiness plan
treatment_plan: Remediate by 2027-03-31; observation period 2027-04-01 to 2027-09-30

threat_event: An attacker on the Tower 1 corporate network reaches the Platform A BAS server through a temporary any-any rule left from the 2025 cutover (found in P07)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Rule not removed after the cutover; no firewall rule review
existing_controls: EDR on the Platform A server
treatment_plan: Remove the rule; quarterly firewall rule review
